subject.title: chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0 in the github-actions group

question: Is the successful cross-platform matrix sufficient for this setup-node major update, or must the Pages and dispatch-only Crabbox workflows run on the exact PR head first?
rationale: Both specialized workflows consume the changed action but are not explicitly represented by successful runtime jobs in the supplied check set, so the required evidence threshold depends on repository automation policy.

options.title: Run specialized workflows
options.body: Trigger or otherwise verify the Pages and Crabbox hydration workflows on the exact PR head before merging.

options.title: Accept matrix coverage
options.body: Merge based on identical pinned usage plus successful workflow lint and cross-platform Node checks.

recommendation.title: Run specialized workflows
recommendation.body: Trigger or otherwise verify the Pages and Crabbox hydration workflows on the exact PR head before merging.
